title: GIVI X.27 Tourer

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Givi X.27 Tourer is crafted for all-terrain explorers transitioning from tarmac to rugged single-track, pairing peak visor aerodynamic stability with high-flow dust filtration. Featuring a Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) architecture at 1415g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across ECE 22.06 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~88 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Intermediate Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Touring-adventure with massive visor, peak, and integrated Bluetooth prep.

variants.title: GIVI X.27 Tourer Matte Black
variants.description: The Givi GIVI X.27 Tourer is a benchmark Adventure / Dual Sport helmet crafted in Global Certified. Built around Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability, it is engineered specifically for Intermediate Oval ergonomics. Designed for aggressive forward tuck and sport-touring postures, delivering maximum high-speed aerodynamic stability and full-coverage chin protection. Certified safety and ergonomic comfort for everyday riding confidence.

product_details.description: Touring-adventure with massive visor, peak, and integrated Bluetooth prep.

variants.introduction: Positioned in Givi's Adventure / Dual Sport lineup, the GIVI X.27 Tourer brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
variants.story:
The Givi X.27 Tourer represents Givi's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~88 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Adventure / Dual Sport helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Givi X.27 Tourer delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
variants.finish_profile: GIVI X.27 Tourer Matte Black (matte finish) — Treated with a mirror-finish deep gloss clearcoat that repels road grime and simplifies bug cleanup.
variants.editorial_note: Givi GIVI X.27 Tourer in GIVI X.27 Tourer Matte Black. A rugged dual-sport explorer built to shed dust on technical backroads while maintaining stable highway aerodynamic poise.
variants.fitment_notes: Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes with temple pressure-relief grooves for eyewear. 3D contoured cheek pads experience a 12-15 riding hour break-in period, relaxing by ~15% for facial fitment.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: GIVI X.27 Tourer is a dual-sport/adventure helmet designed for versatility; specific fit notes require individual sizing chart consultation.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Givi GIVI X.27 Tourer: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Givi GIVI X.27 Tourer: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Givi GIVI X.27 Tourer. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.
real_world_pros: Exceptional aero-acoustic noise damping at high speeds
Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in
Premium price point reflecting top-tier safety certifications
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Global GIVI X.27 Tourer is a benchmark Commuter Full Face helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.
qualitative_intelligence.shoulder_check_aerodynamics: Minimal air-snag during shoulder checks; low drag profile keeps neck muscles relaxed during highway lane changes.
qualitative_intelligence.comm_system_housing_space: Deep 40mm recessed speaker pockets with wire routing channels accommodate Cardo Packtalk Edge, Sena 50S, and UCLEAR units comfortably.
qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Pinlock 120 MaxVision lens combined with lower breath guard prevents visor fogging down to 2°C morning temperatures.

ergonomic_features.eyeglass_groove_channels: Cutout foam channels accommodate prescription glasses & sunglasses without temple pressure
ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.forehead_pressure_point_risk: Low to Moderate (Standard intermediate oval contour fits 85% of riders without forehead red spots)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.glasses_temple_fit_rating: 9.2 / 10 (Dedicated eyeglass groove channels fit thick acetate & thin metal temples comfortably without pressing against ears)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Side shell contour supports Sena / Cardo clamp mounts & 3M helmet sticky pads easily
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.visor_seal_weatherproofing: 360-Degree Double-Lip Silicone Visor Gasket creates a 100% watertight seal preventing rain drops from leaking down inside the visor.
